testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-portal.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-31732 sales rep sees the accounts and users menu and lands on the dashboard

scenario.summary: A sales rep signs in to the admin panel, lands on the Dashboard and sees Accounts & Users (Accounts first, Users second) and OMS (Orders, Quotes, Returns, Pending Orders, Pending Payments, Vouchers); no Customers menu.
steps: Sign in to the admin panel as the sales rep (@rep.userName, @rep.password).
Check the page shown after sign-in.
assertions: After sign-in the Dashboard is displayed
The menu has Accounts & Users with Accounts as the first and Users as the second item
OMS shows Orders, Quotes, Returns, Pending Orders, Pending Payments, Vouchers
evidence: Story Z10-38546 (SalesRep - Phase 2, account association), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-38546/analysis.md sections 3-4 and answers in section 6.
FSD section 10 (navigation structure and rules: Customers renamed to Accounts & Users, Accounts first, Users second) and section 11 (Dashboard displayed immediately after login).
Analysis section 2 and user answer 1 (Dashboard is the landing page, not a menu item).
The sales rep signs in on the suite's admin URL with the password the SALES_REP_OF_STORE collection sets through the API (Phase 1 analysis answer 2).
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store the migrated suites run on (store A), as in the Phase 1 tests.
Overlaps Z10-TC-23096 (Phase 1 menu test, updated to the Phase 2 menu); kept separate as its own AIO case.
